description: Search agency findings by place, case number, status, category and date. record_kind defaults to violation; complaints are reports, not confirmed violations. Sources report data_through, coverage_window and count_unit. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists. Up to 25 results per call. total_capped marks a lower bound; total_unknown means the total is unknown. Pagination guidance is in _notes.

category.description: Normalised category, e.g. HOUSING, UNSAFE, WORK_WITHOUT_PERMIT

city.description: City name (matches the address city or the issuing jurisdiction)

date_after.description: record_date on or after (undated records never match)

include_uncounted.description: Also return records stored but never counted: voided, withdrawn, rescinded or issued in error, and process steps

open_only.description: Only OPEN records (a citation or judgment is not open)

record_kind.description: 'violation' (default): violations, citations and orders the agency found. 'complaint': reports it received, and cases with no evidence a violation was found. 'all': both. Complaints are never counted as violations.

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

status.description: OPEN, CLOSED, COMPLIED, ABATED, CITED, DISMISSED or UNKNOWN

name: search_violations
title: Search code violations
